name: Kuronagi Wakazumi
source:
He's Mikoto's older brother and a first-year university student. Although he is called "brother," he is actually Mikoto and Soushi's cousin. He has a cool and distant aura, but he is overly protective and interfering when it comes to Mikoto. 
He started archery in high school and continued to practice it even after graduation.
translation:
He's Mikoto's older brother and a first-year university student. Although he is called "brother," he is actually Mikoto and Soushi's cousin. He has a cool and distant aura, but he is overly protective and interfering when it comes to Mikoto. 
He started archery in high school and continued to practice it even after graduation.
